name: 48110-mtplongdecode-9b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3, one GPU of an a3 node (--gres=gpu:1).
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, one engine, no router and no external cache tier. Not tunable.
architecture: Qwen3_5ForConditionalGeneration (model_type qwen3_5), bf16, ~9.65B params, ungated, 19.33 GB on the hub. 32 text layers (24 linear_attention, 8 full_attention), hidden 4096, 16 query / 4 KV heads, vocab 248320; the vision tower is dropped at load. Everything else is in the checkpoint's own config.json.
load_profile: concurrent (CLOSED loop), streams=64, bounded at 500 requests with a 1800 s safety cap, 20% warmup and 10% cooldown declared. The cap is not an expectation: expect roughly 7-9 minutes.
workload: guidellm, one synthetic_text spec, every request identical in shape: 500 prompt tokens and 5330 output tokens, both fixed. Output length is exact because guidellm sets ignore_eos=True whenever a row declares output tokens. Prompts are text only and distinct per request. Total offered: 250,000 prompt and 2,665,000 output tokens.
purpose: A long-form report writer on one H100, generating 5,000-plus-token drafts from short prompts for 64 concurrent users.
launch:
model: Qwen/Qwen3.5-9B
tensor-parallel-size: 1
pipeline-parallel-size: 1
data-parallel-size: 1
# The checkpoint is a vision-language model and this workload is text only.
language-model-only: true
# ONE LINE, DELIBERATELY: the engine reads this file line by line and skips indented ones,
# so re-flowing this mapping drops the key and starts without speculative decoding at rc=0.
speculative-config: {"method": "qwen3_next_mtp", "num_speculative_tokens": 2}
enable-prefix-caching: true
# LOAD-BEARING. Do not delete as "the default": pinned so a later change to what the engine
# resolves on its own cannot move the run to a different regime unnoticed.
mamba-cache-mode: align
# The longest request is 500 + 5330 = 5830 tokens; 8192 is the smallest power of two above it.
max-model-len: 8192
# LOAD-BEARING. Do not delete as "the default": the value the engine falls back to depends on
# how it is constructed.
max-num-batched-tokens: 8192
